'''Xiaoying (Maggie) Han''' is a Chinese mathematician whose research concerns [[random dynamical system]]s, [[stochastic differential equation]]s, and [[actuarial science]]. She was the Marguerite Scharnagle Endowed Professor in Mathematics at [[Auburn University]] from 2018 until 2020.{{r|profile}}

==Education and career==
Han graduated from the [[University of Science and Technology of China]] in 2001. She completed her Ph.D. in 2007 at the [[University at Buffalo]].{{r|profile}} Her dissertation, ''Interlayer Mixing in Thin Film Growth'', was supervised by Brian J. Spencer.{{r|mgp}} She joined the Auburn faculty in 2007. She was promoted to full professor in 2017.  She was given the Marguerite Scharnagle Endowed Professorship in 2018, which she held until 2020.{{r|profile}}  Han was named a Fulbright Scholar in 2020, but the Fulbright program shut down during the COVID-19 pandemic, and she was unable to use it for the planned trip to Brazil.<ref name="fulbright">{{cite web |url=http://www.auburn.edu/cosam/news/articles/2020/06/han_awarded_fulbright_grant_to_conduct_research_in_brazil_in_2021.htm|title=Han Awarded Fulbright Grant to Conduct Research in Brazil in 2021|date=June 16, 2020|first=Maria|last=Gebhardt|publisher=Auburn College of Sciences and Mathematics|access-date=August 12, 2025}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Maggie Han - Faculty - Mathematics and Statistics - Auburn University College of Sciences and Mathematics |url=https://www.auburn.edu/cosam/faculty/math_stats/han_x/index.htm |access-date=2025-08-01 |publisher=Auburn College of Sciences and Mathematics |language=en}}</ref>

In 2022, Han was appointed acting deputy associate dean for Academic Affairs in the College of Sciences and Mathematics at Auburn.<ref>{{Cite web |title=DMS Professor Dr. Xiaoying (Maggie) Han appointed COSAM's Acting Deputy Associate Dean for Academic Affairs. |url=https://www.auburn.edu/cosam/news/articles/2022/05/dms_professor_dr._xiaoying_maggie_han_appointed_cosams_acting_deputy_associate_dean_for_academic_affairs..htm |access-date=2025-08-01 |publisher=Auburn College of Sciences and Mathematics}}</ref> In 2023, Han became the permanent associate dean for Academic Affairs.<ref>{{cite web|title=Maggie Han takes new role in COSAM as new Associate Dean for Academic Affairs |url=https://www.auburn.edu/cosam/news/articles/2023/01/maggie_han_takes_new_role_in_cosam_as_new_associate_dean_for_academic_affairs.htm|last=Gebhardt|first=Maria|date=January 17, 2023|publisher=Auburn College of Sciences and Mathematics |access-date=August 12, 2025}}</ref>

== Awards and honors ==
In 2015, Han was awarded the  2015–2017 Jack B. Brown Endowed Faculty Award.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Han selected as the recipient of the 2015-2017 Jack B. Brown Endowed Faculty Award |url=https://www.auburn.edu/cosam//news/articles/2015/03/han-selected-as-the-recipient-of-the-2015-2017-jack-b.-brown-endowed-faculty-award-.htm |access-date=2025-08-01 |publisher=Auburn University}}</ref>

==Books==
Han is the co-author of three books:
*''Applied Nonautonomous and Random Dynamical Systems'' (with T. Caraballo, Springer, 2016){{r|ana}}
*''Attractors Under Discretisation'' (with [[Peter Kloeden|P. E. Kloeden]], Springer, 2017){{r|aud}}
*''Random Ordinary Differential Equations and Their Numerical Solution'' (with P. E. Kloeden, Springer, 2017){{r|rode}}
